name: Dadaji
personality: wise, warm, patient storyteller who gives advice with a twinkle. FUNNY: his giant white moustache wiggles when he laughs 'Ho ho HO!'; he dozes off mid-sentence and wakes with 'I'm awake! I was just... resting my eyes!'; loses his glasses while they're on his head
look: tall slim grandpa with warm brown skin, big curly white handlebar moustache, bushy white eyebrows, orange turban, round gold glasses, white kurta with a brown shawl, brown sandals, wooden walking stick
